_comment: SYNC MANIFEST template. The reviewed list of repositories a product hydrates locally. Consumed by tools/refresh-manifest-repos.sh and the repo-sync skill. Save to records/sync-manifests/releases/<product>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json. Remove all _comment fields before saving.
_comment_review: A manifest is a REVIEWED artifact: reviewedBy and updatedAt are what make it safe to run. An unreviewed manifest is just a list. Amend it through review, never by editing it to make a blocked repository pass.
reviewedBy: {{name of the person who reviewed this list}}
catalogReferences: {{repository:<org>/<repo> — the Context Fabric records this manifest was derived from}}

repositories._comment: id must match the Context Fabric repositoryResource id. url must match the checkout's actual origin remote — the tool refuses to repoint an existing checkout. checkoutDirectory is a bare basename resolved under the declared checkout root.

_comment_localPathException: Only for the rare case of hydrating from a local path rather than a remote. Both fields are required together; the tool refuses a bare local path otherwise. Delete this block if unused.

localPathException.reason: {{why a local path is necessary here}}
